plain_english: Beyond direction-time-touch, firm, changeless, the full Lord — sole maker of hosts of powers dissolving and rising.
Awakening to the self as Śiva-made, maker of creation's rules — how could he wander? Spread out, whence, where, what refuge?
sanskrit_cite: sṛṣṭyādividhisuvedhasam ātmānaṃ śivamayaṃ vibudhyeta | katham iva saṃsārī syād vitatasya kutaḥ kva vā saraṇam

plain_english: Thus proved by reasons: the knower's deed is fruitless. 'Not mine, this — but his': firmly, no fruit in the world.
sanskrit_cite: iti yuktibhir api siddhaṃ yatkarma jñānino na saphalaṃ tat | na mamedam api tu tasyeti dārḍhyato na hi phalaṃ loke

plain_english: Thus awakened by contemplation-wind, sacrificing all thoughts in the blazing self-flame, he becomes flame.
sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ sakalavikalpān pratibuddho bhāvanāsamīraṇataḥ | ātmajyotiṣi dīpte juhvaj jyotirmayo bhavati

plain_english: Eating this or that, covered by anything, calmed, dwelling anywhere — the all-beings-self is freed.
sanskrit_cite: aśnan yad vā tad vā saṃvīto yena kenacic chāntaḥ | yatra kvacana nivāsī vimucyate sarvabhūtātmā

plain_english: Though doing horse-rites by hundred-thousands, brahmin-killings by hundred-thousands — the truth-knower, by merits not, by faults not touched, stainless.
sanskrit_cite: hayamedhaśatasahasrāṇy api kurute brahmaghātalakṣāṇi | paramārthavin na puṇyair na ca pāpaiḥ spṛśyate vimalaḥ

plain_english: Leaving pride, joy, anger, lust, sorrow, fear, greed, delusion; no praise, no formula; dull as if — let him move, opinion-free.
The pride-joy host arises from difference-delusion: how could the nondual-self-awakened be touched by it?
sanskrit_cite: madaharṣaprabhṛtir ayaṃ vargaḥ prabhavati vibhedasaṃmohāt | advaitātmavibodhas tena kathaṃ spṛśyatāṃ nāma

plain_english: Nothing to praise or offer, separate from him, at all: pleased by praise, freed — then no bow, no formula.
sanskrit_cite: stutyaṃ vā hotavyaṃ nāsti vyatiriktam asya kiṃcana ca | stotrādinā sa tuṣyen muktas tan nirnamaskṛtivaṣaṭkaḥ
